create_dependency_container: create a DependencyContainer to register and resolve dependencies by type with optional keys
register_type_in_container: register a type or subclass in a DependencyContainer for automatic instantiation with dependency injection
resolve_dependencies: resolve a registered dependency from a DependencyContainer by type and optional key
wire_object: use wire_object to auto-wire a class instance by resolving typed constructor arguments from a resolver
register_collection_dependencies: register multiple providers for the same type using the collection resolver on a DependencyContainer
